anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sheet the SSD1306 (U4) interface-select pins BS0 (pin 10), BS1 (pin 11) and BS2 (pin 12) are drawn tied together by a vertical wire and pulled up to the VCC rail; BS0 and BS2 are not tied to GND as required for I2C mode.
anomalies.expected: BS0 (pin 10) → GND, BS1 (pin 11) → VCC, BS2 (pin 12) → GND, i.e. BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0, which is the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode strapping used by the rest of the 2-wire DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA interface.

evidence.quote: the SSD1306's own interface-select pins are hard-wired in PCB.net: - BS0 (pin 10) → GND - BS1 (pin 11) → VCC - BS2 (pin 12) → GND
display.kicad_sch (DISPLAY sheet): U4 pins 10 (BS0), 11 (BS1) and 12 (BS2) share one vertical wire that runs up to the VCC rail; no GND connection is drawn on BS0/BS2.

anomalies.impact: With BS2,BS1,BS0 not set to 0,1,0 the SSD1306 is not placed in I2C mode, so the two-wire DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA link from the MCU will not drive the panel and the OLED will not display anything.

parsed.summary: The design matches the specification for all component values and for the NFC, touch, power and programming sections, but the SSD1306 interface-select pins on the DISPLAY sheet appear to be tied together and pulled to VCC instead of the specified 0/1/0 (BS0→GND, BS1→VCC, BS2→GND) I2C strap, which would leave the display undriven.
